Definition: Shelomith, the name of five Israelites and three Israelitesses
BiblicalUsage: Shelomith = "peaceful"; n pr m; 1) a Gershonite Levite, son of Zichri in the time of David; 1a) also 'Shelomoth'; same as H08013; 2) son of king Rehoboam of Judah by Maacah the granddaughter of Absalom; 3) head of a family of exiles who returned with Ezra; n pr f; 4) a woman of Dan, daughter of Dibri, and mother of a son who blasphemed God and was stoned to death in the time of Moses; 5) daughter of Zerubbabel
